meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

copy.tagline: 先制定决策完备的开发计划，再动手写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次动手开发前都想先把计划想清楚
copy.tagline_en: Map out an actionable work plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear plan ready before touching code

howto.what: 装上后,当你说出触发词,Claude 先亮出“ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!”标识,随后以规划顾问身份工作:只读代码、做调研、写计划,只问真正需要你拍板的问题,绝不改产品代码;等你明确批准后才写出一份决策完整、可直接照做的单一工作计划。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-plan”“ulw plan”“make a plan”等关键词,或用自己的话要求在写代码前先做计划时触发;普通写代码请求不会自动进入此模式。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan:先调研再给我一份实施计划
say.note: 进入规划模式,只出计划、不改代码。

say.text: 写代码前先做个计划:给 /login 加每分钟 5 次的 IP 限流
say.note: 意图清晰时,它会直接探索并起草方案。

say.text: interview me:动手前先问我几个关键问题
say.note: 它只问探索答不了的分叉点,再写计划。

howto.what_en: With this skill, on explicit request Claude becomes a planning-only consultant: it explores the codebase, resolves intent, awaits approval, then writes ONE decision-complete plan a worker executes without further interview. It never edits code.
howto.when_en: Activates only when you explicitly ask for a pre-coding plan — say 'ulw-plan', 'ulw plan', 'make a plan', etc., or phrase it in your own words. Ordinary coding requests never self-activate it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan: explore first, then give me an implementation plan.
say_en.note: Enters planning mode; produces a plan, no code edits.

say_en.text: Before coding, make a plan: add a 5/min-per-IP rate limit to /login.
say_en.note: With a clear intent it explores and drafts the plan directly.

say_en.text: Interview me: ask the key questions before drafting the plan.
say_en.note: Only unanswerable forks get asked, then it drafts.
